Rebuild sitemap.xml from the pretty URLs: drop the 408 redirecting catalog_browse.p entries, the cart/login/checkout/404 entries and the 200-status 'Product Not Found' products (e.g. /product/15250006/USA-Team-Beanie.html); add lastmod to the 248 product URLs.

Merge the two Product LD+JSON blocks on each PDP into one with brand, sku/mpn, image, offers.url, offers.availability (schema.org/InStock) and remove the hardcoded aggregateRating 5/326 unless it comes from real reviews; add BreadcrumbList.
